title: UNIT 2 — NUMBERS / IEEE 754
markdown:
#### UNIT 2 — NUMBERS / IEEE 754

08 N-bit Count vs Max〔Quiz〕｜模式数量当最大值 → 共有 2^N 种；Unsigned 最大值=2^N−1

09 +200 in 8-bit Signed〔Quiz〕｜把 11001000 误认为 Signed +200 → Signed 范围 −128..127，+200 不可表示；该位串作 Signed=−56

10 Signed vs Unsigned〔考纲〕｜相同 bits 以为相同数值 → 8-bit MSB=1 时 Signed=Unsigned−256

11 Negative → Two's Complement〔A1〕｜只 Flip、忘 +1 → 写正数 8 bits→反转→加1

12 Sign vs Zero Extension〔考纲〕｜负数扩位左补0 → Signed 复制 MSB；Unsigned 左补0

13 C7 / C8〔A2〕｜C8=1 就叫 Signed Overflow → 只看 C7≠C8；C8 是 unsigned Carry

14 Subtraction / Borrow〔A2〕｜忘记给 Cin=1；把 C8=1 当 Borrow → A−B=A+(~B)+1；Unsigned Borrow ⇔ C8=0

15 Representability vs Overflow〔Quiz/A2〕｜原数无法表示当算术 Overflow → 先判输入是否在范围，再判合法运算结果是否超范围

16 Logical vs Arithmetic Right Shift〔考纲〕｜都左补0 → Logical 补0；Arithmetic 复制旧符号位

17 Mask / Index〔课件〕｜从左数 bit0；Set/Clear 运算符混淆 → bit0 在最右；Test &，Set |，Clear &~，Flip ^；Extract 先 >> 再 &

18 C bitwise vs logical〔课件〕｜& 与 &&、~ 与 ! 混用 → 单符号逐 bit；&&/||/! 判整个值的真假
